resources.string: The assistant needs an API key of your own. It connects to the AI provider you choose — it is not a service of this app, so without a key it cannot answer. Google Gemini, Groq and OpenRouter all have free tiers: add a model below and paste the key in.
No bookmarks yet
Open a page and tap the star in the menu. Bookmarks can be sorted into folders.
Nothing downloaded
Files you save from a page appear here, with their progress and where they went.
No saved passwords
Sign in to a site and the browser offers to remember it. Saved entries can be locked behind your fingerprint.
No cards saved
Add a card to fill in checkout forms without typing the number each time. Cards are stored encrypted on this device.
No user scripts
Scripts change how a site behaves. Add one by hand, or ask the assistant to write it for you.
Nothing planned
Add a task or a meeting, and it will remind you at the time you set. The assistant can add them for you too.
No templates yet
A template is a document you reuse — a quote, an invoice, a letter. Upload your own, or ask the assistant to build one.
No projects yet
Files the assistant creates for you land here — code, documents, archives.
No workflows yet
A workflow is a sequence you repeat, saved under one name so you can ask for it in a few words.
No saved pages
Save a page to read it later without a connection.
Nothing to fill in with
Save your name, address and other details once, and forms fill themselves in afterwards.
